problem.input: A typed exact-transfer instance whose deterministic canonical feedback-interface union B exceeds the prior logarithmic conditioning budget.
problem.prior_scoped_door: |B| <= floor(log2 L) permits raw exact conditioning over all assignments to B followed by the frozen exact tree/message transfer.
problem.new_question: Can exact downstream interface information be represented by a polynomial-size sufficient quotient that is itself discovered, constructed, solved, reconstructed, and verified in polynomial time without enumerating 2^|B| raw assignments?

formal_objects.downstream_query_family: D_B = the frozen exact transfer/message/reconstruction observations that may be asked after conditioning the feedback interface
formal_objects.sufficiency_relation: sigma ~_D tau iff for every d in D_B, d(sigma) = d(tau) under the frozen exact semantics
formal_objects.complete_quotient_condition: q_B(sigma)=q_B(tau) iff sigma ~_D tau when canonical minimality/completeness is claimed

U1_UNRESTRICTED_NO_FREE_COMPRESSION_BARR.statement_to_prove_or_refute: For unrestricted downstream exact predicates over B, there exists a family with |B|=k in which all 2^k raw assignments are pairwise distinguishable by D_B; therefore every exact quotient sufficient for all such downstream predicates has |Q_B| >= 2^k.
acceptable_proof_shape: Construct a frozen family I_k with polynomial description length in the explicit downstream contract representation used by the construction.
For every distinct sigma,tau in {0,1}^k, exhibit or uniformly define a downstream exact query d that distinguishes them.
Prove any semantics-preserving q_B must separate every such pair.
Conclude |Q_B| >= 2^k for that unrestricted query contract.
State the scope carefully: this blocks universal exact compression for unrestricted downstream semantics; it is not a lower bound for general SAT algorithms.
U1_UNRESTRICTED_NO_FREE_COMPRESSION_BARR.forbidden_overclaim: Do not infer P!=NP, a SAT lower bound, or a lower bound for a restricted typed message algebra.

P1_RESTRICTED_EXACT_FACTOR_THROUGH_INVAR.statement_to_prove_or_refute: For a separately frozen strict subclass, there exists a deterministic invariant h_B : Sigma_B -> H_B with |H_B| <= poly(L), constructible without enumerating Sigma_B, such that every frozen downstream transfer/message/reconstruction query factors exactly through h_B.
P1_RESTRICTED_EXACT_FACTOR_THROUGH_INVAR.required_factorization: For every d in D_B there exists an exact ̅d on H_B such that d = ̅d o h_B.
P1_RESTRICTED_EXACT_FACTOR_THROUGH_INVAR.required_lifecycle: T_construct + T_discover + T_solve + T_reconstruct + T_verify <= poly(|F|)
not_in_scope: post-hoc choice of an invariant because finite controls happened to pass

aifc_derived_validation_separation.identity: Freeze canonical source interface, downstream query contract, invariant definition, dependency graph, and target semantics.
aifc_derived_validation_separation.derivation: Recompute q_B/h_B and downstream messages from frozen leaves/dependencies; never trust cached output by assertion.
aifc_derived_validation_separation.adequacy: Independently prove/check that equality of signatures preserves every downstream exact query in scope.
aifc_derived_validation_separation.completeness_basis: If a finite observable basis is claimed complete, prove no omitted exact observable can alter downstream transfer/reconstruction behavior.
aifc_derived_validation_separation.authority_reachability: The constructor/candidate cannot self-authorize adequacy or completeness; checker evidence is separately derived from the frozen contract.
aifc_derived_validation_separation.replay: Independent replay must reproduce canonical signatures, messages, reconstruction output, and certificate hashes.

mandatory_gates.G1_SOURCE_GUARD: The preregistration bytes are frozen before candidate quotient implementation.
mandatory_gates.G2_NO_RAW_ENUMERATION_IN_DISCOVERY: Construction/discovery of h_B/q_B may not enumerate all 2^|B| assignments when |B| is wide.
mandatory_gates.G3_PAIRWISE_ADEQUACY_THEOREM: Every merge is justified by the frozen downstream-equivalence relation, not by hash/name/shape similarity.
mandatory_gates.G4_COMPLETENESS_BASIS: The observable basis used to define signatures is independently shown sufficient for every downstream query in scope.
mandatory_gates.G5_EXACT_RECONSTRUCTION: SAT witnesses or scoped UNSAT certificates reconstruct under the original exact semantics.
mandatory_gates.G6_INDEPENDENT_REPLAY: A separate checker recomputes signatures/messages/certificates from frozen inputs.
mandatory_gates.G7_COMPLEXITY_ACCOUNTING: All lifecycle phases are bounded in the original input length, including invariant discovery and basis verification.
mandatory_gates.G8_FAIL_CLOSED: Unsupported classes return OPEN_* rather than falling back to raw exponential enumeration and calling it polynomial.
mandatory_gates.G9_REGRESSION: Existing Trinity, sealed unicyclic, and canonical-log-feedback gates remain unchanged and green.
mandatory_gates.G10_AUTHORITY_FIREWALL: No candidate/checker may update global P-vs-NP or APMA scientific authority.

falsifiers.F1_INJECTIVE_DOWNSTREAM_IDENTITY: A control whose downstream exact contract exposes enough information that every raw B assignment remains distinguishable; quotient must refuse compression or retain 2^|B| classes.
falsifiers.F2_COLLISION_WITH_DIFFERENT_DOWNSTREAM_M: Supply two assignments with same proposed signature but different exact downstream message; adequacy must fail.
falsifiers.F3_OMITTED_OBSERVABLE: Remove one necessary basis observable so two assignments collide while reconstruction differs; completeness must fail.
falsifiers.F4_POST_HOC_BASIS: A basis selected after observing finite control outcomes must be rejected by source/prereg guard.
falsifiers.F5_DISCOVERY_ENUMERATION: A constructor that scans all raw assignments is rejected even if the final Q_B is small.
falsifiers.F6_HASH_ONLY_DEDUP: Equal metadata/hash naming without semantic downstream proof is rejected as compression evidence.
falsifiers.F7_RENAMING_ONLY: Structural renaming equivalence is insufficient when downstream exact labels/relations distinguish states.
falsifiers.F8_AUTHORITY_SELF_PROMOTION: A successor artifact claiming its own completeness without frozen authority/replay evidence is rejected.

positive_controls.PCTRL_AFFINE_SYNDROME: Construct a strict linear interface family where downstream semantics depends only on a frozen rank-r GF(2) syndrome with r <= O(log L) or otherwise |im A| <= poly(L); verify exact factorization without enumerating 2^|B| inputs.
positive_controls.PCTRL_FACTORIZED: Construct an exactly disconnected/factorized wide B where downstream transfer is a product of polynomially represented local messages; verify no cross-product materialization is required.
positive_controls.PCTRL_TYPED_FINITE: If available without post-hoc invention, construct a finite typed message algebra with polynomially many canonical reachable classes and exact composition/reconstruction.

negative_controls.NCTRL_IDENTITY_QUERY: Downstream query returns the full raw B assignment; exact quotient must have 2^|B| classes and therefore fail the polynomial-size compression gate for wide B.
negative_controls.NCTRL_ONE_BIT_OMITTED: Candidate invariant drops a bit that an exact downstream predicate reads; adequacy must fail.
negative_controls.NCTRL_NONLINEAR_ESCAPE: A family outside the declared affine/factorized/finite-typed subclass must remain OPEN_UNSUPPORTED_INTERFACE_ALGEBRA.

promotion_rule.U1: May only establish a scoped representation/query-contract barrier. It cannot be promoted to P!=NP or a general SAT lower bound.
promotion_rule.P1: May only extend exact transfer to the explicitly frozen strict subclass whose factorization/adequacy/completeness/lifecycle obligations all pass.
promotion_rule.global: No automatic promotion of the APMA unseen-local-invariant frontier or P-vs-NP status.

next_step_after_freeze: Implement a source-guarded formal candidate containing (a) the unrestricted distinguishability barrier proof/certificate and (b) the first restricted affine-syndrome quotient, followed by an independently written checker and GitHub Actions gate.
